fields.label: Lab
fields.description: Select lab first — only tests/standards in that lab's scope will be suggested

fields.label: Lab Initials
fields.description: Fetched from Laboratory — shown in Lab search, not as a separate column

fields.label: Test Name
fields.description: Only tests in the selected lab's accreditation scope

fields.label: Standard
fields.description: Only standards offered by this lab for the selected test

fields.label: Test Description
fields.description: Shown to the customer with the test line

fields.label: Purchase Price (internal)
fields.description: Lab buy / cost — editable for staff; never shown to the customer on Print/PDF

fields.label: Unit Price
fields.description: Customer-facing unit price (printed as Price). Editable. Total Price = Unit Price × No. of Samples

fields.label: No. of Samples
fields.description: Editable on Template and every Quotation line. Total Price = Unit Price × No. of Samples. Also drives Sample Required text on print.

fields.label: Selling Price / Unit
fields.description: Mirrors Suggested Selling Price for totals

fields.label: Sample Required (print text)
fields.description: Shown under Samples Requirements on the Testing quote. Auto-fills from No. of Samples; edit freely on Template and Quotation.

fields.label: Laboratory Location
fields.description: Fetched from Lab; editable override for this quote line

fields.label: Laboratory Accreditation
fields.description: Editable — shown when needed on internal notes
